scope.model: Local deterministic HTTP Responses fixture; no paid model
scope.data: Fresh isolated directory; generated tasks accumulate during this run. Not a 100,000-event historical-data scenario.
scope.exclusions: No four-hour soak, UI latency, cold-cache OS startup, real-provider performance, macOS/Linux or clean-Windows claim.
scope.percentiles: Nearest-rank p50/p95; all samples retained, no best-run selection.
scope.resources: 250ms external process sampling; collector and Node fixture are excluded from engine measurements. CPU normalized over all logical processors.

stopping.boundary: Cancellation IPC acknowledgement is separate from a UI click-to-feedback measurement. Tree exit checks both actual PIDs; heartbeat verification is not included in exit timing.

resourceError: Resource sampling missed a required process or load phase
